name: qfd_su_lane_t_i2-i3-f2c5ac85b
purpose: SU lane cluster (64 per qfd_sp_su64_sfu), r8 successor of CLOSED qfd_su_lane_t_io-io1-60bc0119d (TT +89.97 / FF +25.72 / DRC 0) whose native pin audit FAILS: TT R 920.9, capture 555 inputs > 190 (max crom_q[2] 298.6), launch vc_addr[21] 223.4, boundary clock 817.8..965.7 (148 ps). Same RTL (IREG=1 OREG=1). Cause measured on the routed io1 netlist/STA: (1) the clock port sat at W y 66.5, the four child clock pins sit on the middle channel y 155.5..190.1, so the spine reached u_rcp through 12 BUFx24 (~545 ps) and every parent pin flop was padded by ~600 ps of HB4/BUF chains to match (R 921), whose post-route variation spread the boundary to 148 ps; (2) the 30-ps route hold margin applied to IO added 3 BUFx2 per input on top of the HB2 pad (wrom_q[100] FF hold slack +40, crom_q[2] +103 at sign-off).
